body:
SWEEP 3 SLICE THREE LANDED 0b414b4. core 1/1, document 1/1, embed-core 3/3.

RUNNING TOTAL: 30 OF 30 MEASURED FORGEABLE, across SEVEN modules and three nesting shapes --
top-level, and nested inside an object beside a sealed trait. No exceptions anywhere.

I ALSO VERIFIED THE 38 ITSELF rather than trusting the grep that produced it: align 6, codec 2,
core 1, document 1, embed-core 3, features 4, view 21 = 38 distinct names. The headline number holds
-- AND IT CORRECTS MY OWN ACCOUNTING. I have twice said the remainder was "in core, codec and
align", naming three modules when it is five. document and embed-core went unmentioned and were free
the entire time; I could have measured them two hours ago.

Measuring before writing also saved three wrong names: Plain/Keyed/Withheld are nested in `object
ReceiptDigest`, so they qualify as ReceiptDigest.Plain, not storymodel4s.embed.Plain. Writing the
probe from the grep output alone would have produced three compile errors and looked like a defect.

ONLY align (6) AND codec (2) REMAIN. Both hold batch-1 candidates and stay untouched until it
clears. CostBreakdown is among the align six and remains slice one by exposure.
